title: Random Cube Generator
description: Practice 3D rotation and perspective construction with a randomized geometric volume.

title: Rotation Grid
description: Study standard drafting angles (15°, 30°, 45°) and observe how position within the cone of vision alters foreshortening.

title: Blind Contour
description: Draw the edges of a museum object without looking at your paper, against a timer.

title: Verify Cubes
description: Photograph a cube you drew and see the lines the tool finds in it.

title: Upside Down
description: Copy a line drawing shown upside down, so you draw the lines you see instead of what you think the subject is.
